origin.description: Builds a missing double that stores one tag letter.

arguments.text: One-character tags, usually letters a to z.

origin.details: The value is R's NA real with the tag written into one byte. On import from SAS or Stata the tag is lower case.
origin.value: A double vector of tagged missing values.
